title: Secure configuration guides (CIS Benchmarks) and automation

videos.script: Lesson one hardened one server by eye. That does not scale to the fortieth. {{guide}} A configuration guide is the same work, written down once, with the argument for every setting. {{lynis}} You will audit the portal with Lynis, and read its warnings as questions, not orders. {{scap}} Then a standard scanner, OpenSCAP, with a guide written for the wrong release. Watch it refuse to measure anything. {{check}} Then your own baseline: seven controls, each a command that answers yes or no. {{ansible}} And the fix, as an Ansible playbook you can run twice and run every night. {{drift}} Finally, somebody changes the server by hand. The playbook sees nothing. The check sees it at once.
